open-tv-browser.description:
Open TV Browser is a lightweight and highly optimized browser designed specifically for Android TV and Smart TVs.
Although it has been discontinued, it remains an excellent browser and still works remarkably well on compatible devices.
Its built-in ad blocking provides a much cleaner and less distracting browsing experience.
The interface is extremely remote-friendly, making navigation, scrolling, tabs, and browsing easy with a TV remote.
It is fast, smooth, and lightweight, making it especially useful on older or low-RAM Android TVs.
If you want a simple, powerful, and genuinely TV-optimized browser, Open TV Browser is still a fantastic choice.
